title: Clinical Risk Models, Inflammatory-Nutritional Indices and a Neural-Network Survival Model in Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma: A Single-Center Retrospective Study.
summary: Neural network predicts death risk and survival time; predictors screened/tuned within repeated stratified 5-fold CV (50 outer folds), compared on identical splits with Cox and random survival forest. n=96, C-index 0.685 vs IMDC+nephrectomy Cox 0.692 and RSF 0.695; worse Brier score/calibration slope 0.54. A dual-head neural-network survival model was evaluated against IMDC/MSKCC and Cox/forest benchmarks in a 96-patient retrospective mRCC cohort using repeated nested cross-validation. Its C-index was comparable to Cox and forest models but calibration and Brier error were worse; this is explicitly exploratory.
